title: PB Sweet Crepe
description: Light French crepes drizzled with a powdered peanut butter sauce.
steps: Whisk flour, egg, milk, sweetener and salt until smooth.
Mix powdered peanuts with a splash of water to thick drizzle.
Heat oiled pan (24cm) on medium; pour ladle of batter; swirl to cover.
Cook 30–45 sec; flip; cook 2–3 min total per crepe.
Roll crepes; drizzle peanut sauce on top.
notes: 100g greek yogurt makes a great topping or filling alternative.
